queries.query: SELECT mean("usage_system") AS "system", mean("usage_user") AS "user", mean("usage_idle") AS "idle" FROM ":db:".":rp:"."cpu" WHERE "host" = :host: AND time > :dashboardTime: AND "cpu" = 'cpu-total' GROUP BY time(:interval:) FILL(null)
queries.label: CPU Usage

detailQueries.query: SELECT mean("usage_system") AS "system", mean("usage_user") AS "user" FROM ":db:".":rp:"."cpu" WHERE time > :dashboardTime: AND time < :upperDashboardTime: AND "cpu"='cpu-total' AND "host"=':host:' GROUP BY time(:interval:) FILL(null)
detailQueries.label: cpu-usage

detailQueries.query: SELECT mean("usage_idle") AS "idle" FROM ":db:".":rp:"."cpu" WHERE time > :dashboardTime: AND time < :upperDashboardTime: AND "cpu"='cpu-total' AND "host"=':host:' GROUP BY time(:interval:) FILL(null)
detailQueries.label: cpu-idle

detailQueries.query: SELECT mean("usage_nice") AS "nice" FROM ":db:".":rp:"."cpu" WHERE time > :dashboardTime: AND time < :upperDashboardTime: AND "cpu"='cpu-total' AND "host"=':host:' GROUP BY time(:interval:) FILL(null)
detailQueries.label: cpu-nice

detailQueries.query: SELECT mean("usage_iowait") AS "iowait" FROM ":db:".":rp:"."cpu" WHERE time > :dashboardTime: AND time < :upperDashboardTime: AND "cpu"='cpu-total' AND "host"=':host:' GROUP BY time(:interval:) FILL(null)
detailQueries.label: cpu-io-wait

detailQueries.query: SELECT mean("usage_steal") AS "steal" FROM ":db:".":rp:"."cpu" WHERE time > :dashboardTime: AND time < :upperDashboardTime: AND "cpu"='cpu-total' AND "host"=':host:' GROUP BY time(:interval:) FILL(null)
detailQueries.label: cpu-steal

detailQueries.query: SELECT mean("usage_irq") AS "irq" FROM ":db:".":rp:"."cpu" WHERE time > :dashboardTime: AND time < :upperDashboardTime: AND "cpu"='cpu-total' AND "host"=':host:' GROUP BY time(:interval:) FILL(null)
detailQueries.label: cpu-irq

detailQueries.query: SELECT mean("usage_softirq") AS "softirq" FROM ":db:".":rp:"."cpu" WHERE time > :dashboardTime: AND time < :upperDashboardTime: AND "cpu"='cpu-total' AND "host"=':host:' GROUP BY time(:interval:) FILL(null)
detailQueries.label: cpu-soft-irq

detailQueries.query: SELECT mean("load1") AS "01 min", mean("load5") AS "05 min", mean("load15") AS "15 min" FROM ":db:".":rp:"."system" WHERE time > :dashboardTime: AND time < :upperDashboardTime: AND "host"=':host:' GROUP BY time(:interval:) FILL(null)
detailQueries.label: cpu-load

queries.query: SELECT mean("used_percent") AS "last_used_percent" FROM ":db:".":rp:"."mem" WHERE time > :dashboardTime: AND "host"=:host: GROUP BY time(:interval:) FILL(previous)
queries.label: Memory Usage

queries.query: SELECT last("total")/1073741824 AS "total_gib", last("used")/1073741824 AS "used_gib", last("free")/1073741824 AS "free_gib", last("used_percent") AS "used_percent", last("inodes_used_percent") AS "inode_used_percent" FROM ":db:".":rp:"."disk" WHERE time > :dashboardTime: AND "host"=:host: GROUP BY "path"
queries.label: Disk Usage

queries.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(max("bytes_recv"), 1s) AS "received", non_negative_derivative(max("bytes_sent"), 1s) AS "sent" FROM ":db:".":rp:"."net" WHERE time > :dashboardTime: AND "host" = :host: GROUP BY time(:interval:) FILL(null)
queries.label: Network Traffic

queries.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(max("read_bytes"),1s) AS "read bytes", non_negative_derivative(max("write_bytes"),1s) AS "write bytes" FROM ":db:".":rp:"."diskio" WHERE time > :dashboardTime: AND "host" = :host: GROUP BY time(:interval:) FILL(null)
queries.label: Disk I/O Usage

queries.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(max("io_time"), 1s)/10 AS "io_percent" FROM ":db:".":rp:"."diskio" WHERE "host" = :host: AND time > :dashboardTime: GROUP BY "name", time(:interval:) FILL(null)
queries.label: Disk Utilization

query.influxql: SHOW TAG VALUES ON :database: FROM :measurement: WITH KEY=:tagKey:
